audit.whatIsWrong: Four rows disagree with the packet and with their own whys: win[0]='Wukong' beside whys[0] 'Level 1 is even'; win[1]='Skill' beside whys[1] 'his turrets and Micro-Rockets zone you off the wave'; win[4]='Wukong' beside whys[4] 'Level 6 is an even beat'; win[6]='Heimerdinger' beside whys[6] 'you dive the squishy Heimer'.
audit.why: Packet chart: Skill, Heimerdinger, Heimerdinger, Heimerdinger, Skill, Heimerdinger, Wukong. The heimerdinger__wukong mirror was flipped to exactly this on rows 2, 6 and 2+ items. The packet also carries a defect note that the chart looks Heimerdinger-heavy against a 52.58% Wukong win rate — that is real, but it resolves in the 2+ items row, which is where Wukong's lead lives.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 4 and 6 flipped in matched full/content pairs, with ratings rescaled to 5/10, 4/10, 5/10 and 6/10.

audit.why: Heimerdinger's spikes are the turret grid (Q, 1s but mana-gated at 20 per cast), Micro-Rockets rank-ups (11/10/9/8/7s at 1325 range), and AP items. His level 6 is UPGRADE!!! at 100/85/70s. Wukong's only real spike here is the two-item window once fights leave the nest.
audit.corrected: spikes[1] now states what UPGRADE!!! actually does rather than calling it a 'rocket nuke'.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two problems. (1) The grenade is called 'CH-3X Grenade' in three places — spikes[1], early and wants.you[0]. The ability is CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade, and the page's own full layer calls it CH-2 everywhere, so the content layer contradicts the full layer on the enemy's ability name. (2) UPGRADE!!! is described as a 'rocket nuke'. Riot's text: 'Heimerdinger invents an upgrade, causing his next spell to have increased effects' — it empowers whichever spell he casts next, and on the grenade that means a much longer stun, which is the version that actually kills you.
audit.why: Riot E text: 'lobs a grenade at a location, dealing damage to enemy units, as well as stunning anyone directly hit and slowing surrounding units', 11s at every rank, 970 range. Riot R text as quoted above.
audit.corrected: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade, 11s flat at all ranks — only a DIRECT hit stuns, the surrounding area merely slows. UPGRADE!!! empowers his next spell, so an empowered grenade is the longer stun to fear.

audit.whatIsWrong: The grenade is named page-wide as the cooldown to track but never given its number, and the page never distinguishes a direct hit from the edge.
audit.why: 11s flat at every rank means the window does not shrink as he levels — unusually stable, and worth saying. The direct-hit-versus-edge distinction is the difference between a stun and a slow.
audit.corrected: Both written into report[5].t and dontsFull[1].d.

audit.why: Riot's passive: 'Gain Move Speed while near allied towers and turrets deployed by Heimerdinger.' It means he kites faster inside his own grid than outside it, which is why chasing him through the nest fails even when your cooldowns are up.
audit.corrected: Recorded here; I could not fit it into an existing field inside the length band without dropping something more decisive.

edits.before: Level 6 is a rare even beat — his UPGRADE!!! (R) is up but so is your R Cyclone, so you can bait the CH-3X Grenade (E) with your W decoy and answer his rocket nuke with a committed all-in when his stun is down.
edits.after: Level 6 is a rare even beat — UPGRADE!!! empowers his next spell, and on the CH-2 Grenade (E) that is a far longer stun. Bait the grenade with your W decoy, then commit: it is 11s flat, the same at every rank.

edits.before: Level 1 is even before his turrets go up, but Heimerdinger takes the lane from level 2 onward: his Q turret grid and W Hextech Micro-Rockets zone you off the wave, and any careless step lets him land the CH-3X Grenade (E) stun and dump turret focus on you.
edits.after: Level 1 is even before his turrets go up, but Heimerdinger takes the lane from level 2 onward: his Q turret grid and W Hextech Micro-Rockets zone you from 1325 range, and any careless step lets him land the CH-2 Grenade (E) stun and dump turret focus on you.

edits.before: Dodge the CH-3X Grenade (E) stun before engaging
edits.after: Dodge the CH-2 Grenade (E) stun before engaging

edits.before: Track Heimerdinger's CH-2 Grenade (Stun): His self-peel stun. Decoy it. When it is down — E-Q + R him.
edits.after: CH-2 Grenade is 11s at every rank — only a direct hit stuns; the edge just slows. Clone it, then commit.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: A direct CH-2 hit stuns; clipping the edge only slows you.

notes: The content layer invented 'CH-3X Grenade' in three places while the full layer of the same matchup correctly said CH-2 — the two layers were printing different names for the same enemy ability. Fixed all three. Also corrected UPGRADE!!! from 'rocket nuke' to what Riot's text says: it empowers his NEXT spell, so the dangerous version is an empowered CH-2 Grenade with a much longer stun, not a bigger rocket volley. Level chart: four rows disagreed with the packet and with their own whys; flipped in matched pairs to align with the heimerdinger__wukong mirror. NOT WRITTEN, worth a future pass: Hextech Affinity gives him move speed near his own turrets and allied towers, which is the real reason chasing him inside the nest fails — it appears nowhere on the page and I had no field with room for it.
